note: Short-term trades (owner, 27 Nov 2026): ₦300-500K split into ₦200K Zenith + ₦200K GTCO now, ₦100K reserve. Profit is counted after fees (~2% each way) and includes dividends received (after 10% withholding tax). Take profit 1: +10% net, sell half. Take profit 2: +20% net, sell the rest. Protect: after take profit 1, sell the rest if the net gain falls back to +5%. Stop: sell all at 10% below the all-in unit cost (lowered by any dividend received). Hold at most 6 months, then review. Reserve: use only if a trade is 5%+ below its entry. Buy with a limit at most 1% above the planned price; if the price runs 5%+ above it, wait. Record each buy and sell here (buys/sells with date, units, price, total incl. fees, account) from the contract notes; the refresh checks every open trade.
